previous_findings_resolution.resolution: Resolved inside the unit. src/api/diagnosesApi.ts completeDiagnosis -> withPendingBlocks (L61-91) rereads the stored draft on a 422 incomplete without a block list and recomputes the list with the shared pendingBlocks(); readPendingBlocks (L94-98) then returns the list. Reproduced independently with 6 vitest cases (see evidence): server shape yields the 8 expected blocks with a POST then GET; details shape reads directly with no GET; 409, failed GET and network failure yield null. The transport mismatch itself (src/api/httpClient.ts) is still present; see finding 3.

The 422 incomplete body from the server carries pendingBlocks beside code and message (server/services/diagnosisService.ts:90, server/http/errorHandler.ts:77), but httpClient toApiError (src/api/httpClient.ts:60-73) keeps only error.details. The questionnaire works around it with one extra GET of the draft (diagnosesApi.ts withPendingBlocks), so AC-dm-14 is met on the user path, but the transport and server disagree and the workaround duplicates the server completeness check on the client. Owner outside this unit: phase-1-backend-diagnoses (nest the list under error.details) or phase-1-frontend-primitives (keep unknown error keys in details). Integration decides which.
findings.failure_scenario: If the server rules change without the client's shared check changing too, the recomputed list could differ from the server list. Today both use shared/domain/completeness.ts, so no observed defect.

evidence.result: exit 0; 1 file, 6 tests passed. messages.text: 422 incomplete transport mismatch is still open. Recommended: nest pendingBlocks under error.details in server/http/errorHandler.ts (owner phase-1-backend-diagnoses) or keep unknown error keys in details in src/api/httpClient.ts toApiError (owner phase-1-frontend-primitives). When aligned, withPendingBlocks in src/api/diagnosesApi.ts sees details and skips its extra GET; no frontend change is needed.

Regression probe lives only in the run-scoped execution-temp directory and is removed on engine completion. Move the 6 cases (mock fetch: POST /api/diagnoses/:id/complete 422 incomplete with and without a list, GET draft) into tests/unit so they survive, as the implementer suggested. Then run the e2e specs and the browser walkthrough listed in findings 1 and 2: start the app and backend with the project's dev script, answer a question, reload the diagnosis URL, confirm 'Salvo automaticamente às HH:MM', click 'Ver meu resultado' with an unanswered block, confirm the pending alert links, cancel and confirm the gate, then cancel and confirm 'Descartar rascunho'.
